scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:app && npm run test:server
scripts.test:server: php server/tools/test.php && php server/tools/mail-test.php && php server/tools/mail-app-test.php && php server/tools/abuse-test.php && php server/tools/shared-login-test.php && php server/tools/app-signin-test.php
scripts.export:web: npm -w app exec expo export -- -p web && node tools/patch-web-html.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:shared: npm run export:web && playwright test -c playwright.shared.config.ts
scripts.test:desktop: sh desktop/check-assets.sh && sh desktop/test-signin.sh && bash desktop/test-smoke.sh
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/app
